business_summary: Sophia Holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the information and communication technology businesses in Japan. The company operates in three segments: Internet related business; Communication Business; Dispensing pharmacies and related businesses; and Others segments. It provides planning, design development, business contracting, and consulting services for web services; data-only, voice-enabled SIM services, and comprehensive support to companies and organizations considering launching mobile services; procurement and planning design to operation and management system implementation for MVNO business launches; telecommunications services, such as mobile to fixed-line lines, including sales of cloudWi-Fi, smartphone devices, ISPs, and IP phone system construction; management support, such as checking the progress of business plans, as well as coordinates medical care with visiting physicians and nurses, and also provide medication guidance at patients' homes. The company was formerly known as Sophia Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sophia Holdings Co.,Ltd. in April 2007. Sophia Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
